page_title: TOT 2-1 LIV | Tottenham Hotspur v Liverpool 30/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Alejo Veliz (Tottenham) picks up a yellow card.
90+7' The game is interrupted. Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
90+6' 2 - 1 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Joel Matip (Liverpool), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 2:1.
90+5' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) is penalised.
90+2' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Yves Bissouma is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham).
90' The game has come to an end for James Maddison. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Alejo Veliz (Tottenham).
90' It's like he was asking for a caution. Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) receives a yellow card.
88' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
87' What was Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
86' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) gets in a good position to shoot just outside the box after a nice pass, but his effort is unintentionally blocked by one of his teammate.
85' James Maddison (Tottenham) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
83' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a change. Oliver Skipp (Tottenham) replaces Pape Matar Sarr.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ben Davies (Tottenham) replaces Destiny Udogie.
82' One of the Tottenham players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.

81' James Maddison (Tottenham) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball. The referee blows his whistle, Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
81' Tottenham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
81' The substitution is prepared. Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alexis Mac Allister.
80' Manor Solomon (Tottenham) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
79' Tottenham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
79' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. It will be a corner kick for Tottenham.
77' The attendance is 62001.
76' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.

76' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
75' The referee awards a corner and Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) goes over to take it.
74' Substitution. Mohamed Salah makes way for Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool).
73' Jurgen Klopp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) replacing Joe Gomez.
73' Substitution. Wataru Endo (Liverpool) replaces Luis Diaz.
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Tottenham comes to nothing.

69' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) must have known he would be sent off for this foul, but he had to stop the opponent at all costs. Simon Hooper shows him a second yellow card and the game has ended for him.
69' Substitution. Manor Solomon (Tottenham) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Heung-Min Son walks off.
69' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
67' A cross from a corner kick by Tottenham is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
66' Tottenham take a short corner kick.
65' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
61' The resulting set piece from Tottenham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
60' The resulting corner from James Maddison (Tottenham) is cleared.
59' A goal, which was scored by Heung-Min Son (Tottenham), was disallowed due to offside.

58' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) after he collected a pass and unleashed a shot. The ball was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.
56' Great teamplay by Tottenham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
52' Tottenham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Tottenham. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Tottenham.

51' A sweet pass finds Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the roof of the net. Alisson is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The referee signals a corner kick to Tottenham.
50' Tottenham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

49' James Maddison (Tottenham) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and produces a ferocious strike towards the left post, but his shot is well held by the goalkeeper. Tottenham force a corner. They send men into the box.
46' Jurgen Klopp has made a change at the break. Diogo Jota (Liverpool) has come on in place of Cody Gakpo.
46' Referee Simon Hooper blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+8' CHANCE! Luis Diaz (Liverpool) connects with a cross but he cannot direct his shot on target.
45+4' 1 - 1 GOAL! Virgil van Dijk meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 1:1.
45+3' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
43' Richarlison (Tottenham) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post.
41' A pass travels right across the box to Richarlison (Tottenham) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the top left corner, but Alisson denies him with a decent save.
40' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) was quite harsh and Simon Hooper didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
39' The resulting corner from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) comes to nothing.

36' 1 - 0 Richarlison produces a sweet pass and picks out Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 1:0!
35' Celebrations are cut short for Liverpool as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
35' Attention! Referee Simon Hooper straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
34' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Luis Diaz (Liverpool) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.

33' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Richarlison (Tottenham), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.

30' James Maddison (Tottenham) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Alisson pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
26' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Curtis Jones (Liverpool). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.
25' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Curtis Jones (Liverpool)! Let's see what he decides.
24' Tempers flare after Curtis Jones (Liverpool) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
24' Tottenham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
20' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
19' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away. Liverpool will take a corner kick.
18' The corner is swung in but Tottenham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
18' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Tottenham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
16' It looks like Luis Diaz (Liverpool) saw red with that tackle. Simon Hooper won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
14' Liverpool have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

14' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) quickly picks up the rebound and drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save to deny him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Liverpool are going to take it.

13' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Guglielmo Vicario anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
12' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
11' Richarlison (Tottenham) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
9' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
8' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Richarlison (Tottenham) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Destiny Udogie. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.

5' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
4' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

4' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
2' Richarlison (Tottenham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
1' The first half has started.
Liverpool will kick-off.
Simon Hooper will officiate today.
